summary: End-to-end frontend testing of SynapseEDU Learning Hub (client-side demo). All pages load correctly and the full learning loop (login -> dashboard -> upload -> topics -> topic -> tutor -> quiz -> results -> revision -> progress -> dashboard) works as specified. Deterministic scoring produces expected 3/5 (60%) and AIMD Algorithm mastery increases from 36% to 60% while overall mastery rises from 59% to 62%, demonstrating the measurable-improvement core loop. Sidebar collapses to hamburger below 992px.

issues: Option letter prefix (A/B/C/D) is concatenated with the answer text with no space, e.g. 'AIncreased by 1 MSS each RTT'. Consider adding whitespace or a separate letter chip element.

critical_code_review_comments: Quiz option renderer concatenates the letter label directly to the option text (no separator). Minor UX polish - split into <span class='opt-letter'> and <span class='opt-text'>.
test_credentials: Demo login button on /login.html (email demo@synapse.edu / password demo1234 pre-filled).
seed_data_creation: None - app is fully client-side with seeded demo dataset (Computer Networks) in demo-data.js and localStorage key synapse_state_v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by 'serve' at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Start at /login.html and click [data-testid=demo-login]. Deterministic mastery formula: 3/5 quiz on AIMD raises AIMD from 36% -> 60%. All interactive elements carry data-testid. No backend calls occur in preview - API_BASE_URL is intentionally empty. Verified AIMD quiz correct answers per prompt: Q1 opt-1, Q2 opt-0, Q3 opt-2, Q4 opt-1, Q5 opt-1.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failing behaviour observed. Only cosmetic note: quiz option letter/answer are concatenated without whitespace due to template joining.
